sourceNotes.calendar: Import with Google Calendar or an .ics file. This app does not continuously sync your calendar.
sourceNotes.location: Import a Google Timeline export. Background GPS tracking is not connected.
sourceNotes.health: Read supported Health Connect or Apple Health data in the native app, after consent. File imports are also available.
sourceNotes.garmin: Enable Garmin Connect sharing to Apple Health (iOS) or Health Connect (Android 14+), then import supported data in the installed app. Direct Garmin connection and Body Battery import are not supported yet.
sourceNotes.tasks: Import Google Tasks through the existing account flow. Changes are not continuously synced.
sourceNotes.kakao: Import a KakaoTalk chat export and review the selected signals. Live private chats are not read.
sourceNotes.sms: Import an SMS backup file. This app does not read your inbox directly.
sourceNotes.instagram: No direct Instagram connection in this app. Add a link or a note you choose.
sourceNotes.facebook: No direct Facebook connection in this app. Add a link or a note you choose.
sourceNotes.x: No direct X connection in this app. Add a link or a note you choose.
sourceNotes.nike: No direct Nike Run Club connection in this app. Record a run or use activity already shared to a supported health source.
sourceNotes.line: No private LINE chat connection in this app. Manually record only what you choose.
sourceNotes.whatsapp: No private WhatsApp chat connection in this app. Manually record only what you choose.

push.web: Browser notifications are not connected. Use calendar export in the assistant or set reminders in the native app.
push.unknown: Could not read this device's notification settings.
push.granted: Permission granted. {{count}} routine alerts are scheduled on this device. These are local reminders, not server push.
push.unavailable: Local reminders need a compatible installed app. This runtime cannot schedule them.
push.permission: Notification permission is not granted. Open reminders to choose a routine and request permission.

phone.controlNote: Turn off permissions and consent in their settings. Review imported data separately in import history.
phone.sourceScope: Only records you saved or imports you approved. A past import does not mean a live connection. Import history is local to this device.
phone.partialError: Some information is unavailable. The other sections remain usable.
phone.noData: No data has been read yet.
